ChaeSong-hwa expresses her anticipation and excitement for the completed garden project. She envisions the garden as a "beautiful spot for everyone" and highlights its potential as a "gathering spot full of life and laughter." ChaeSong-hwa is particularly keen on the idea that the garden will serve as a communal space where members of the community can come together and enjoy one another's company. She appears to be very supportive and enthusiastic about the collective effort to create a welcoming and enjoyable environment.
